7620432610728135957.desc: Travel Tips for Siem Reap & Angkor Wat, Cambodia - Kinh nghiệm du lịch Angkor Wat, Campuchia ​1. Getting There ​By Bus: If you’re coming from Phnom Penh or Vietnam, you can easily travel by bus. It’s best to book your tickets through online travel apps. ​By Air: Flights are available from Phnom Penh, Saigon (HCMC), Hanoi, and Nha Trang. Air Cambodia and Vietjet Air offer quite affordable rates. ​2. Accommodation & Connectivity ​Where to stay: There are plenty of budget-friendly hotels near the Old Market or across the river. ​Connectivity: I highly recommend buying a local SIM card. In my experience, Metfone provides stable coverage in both the city center and rural areas. ​Essential Apps: Once you have a SIM, download Tada or PassApp to hail tuk-tuks, and eMoney for easy QR payments everywhere. ​3. Dining & Services ​While there are many great spots in the city center, I suggest exploring Street 22. It’s lined with charming cafes and professional hair salons if you're looking for a haircut or a relaxing hair wash. ​4. Exploring Angkor Wat ​Timing: Start your day early, around 5:00 AM, to beat the heat. Don't worry, it’s very safe at that hour. ​Tickets: I recommend the 3-day pass because the Angkor complex is vast with so many hidden gems to discover. ​5. Nightlife ​Vibrant: Head to Pub Street and the riverside areas for a lively, fun atmosphere. ​Peaceful: If you prefer tranquility, visit the Royal Independence Garden, or take a stroll along National Road 6 and River Rd. ​6. Unique Experiences & Local Support ​Don't miss out on Tonle Sap (Great Lake). You’ll find floating fishing villages there, including communities of Vietnamese origin. Please consider supporting them as their living conditions are still quite challenging. ​During my recent visits, many locals shared that their livelihoods have been impacted by border conflicts and one-sided news about online s cams in Cambodia. However, Siem Reap remains very safe and absolutely worth visiting. It's better to travel with backpacks for this itinerary. If you prefer to stay at Vienna during your hole stay, check my next tiktoks ! You can arrive at Vienna and take your return flight at Innsbruck. If you prefer to take your return flight at Vienna, plan a day to go back to Vienna because Vienna airport is 5h away from Innsbruck by train.
